child.text:
[{"insert":"Front Rack Split Squat

The front rack split squat holds the weight up on your shoulders, which makes your core and upper back work harder to stay tall than a goblet or suitcase hold would. The split stance trains one leg at a time. Keep your front heel flat and drive through it on every rep. Reps drop every other week so you can keep adding weight.
"}]
